overview: Voyagr is a complete travel booking app mockup displayed inside a realistic iPhone frame. It covers all flight and hotel booking flows with Orange and Blue theme, bottom tab navigation, and mobile-first UX.
features: iPhone frame mockup with Dynamic Island and status bar
Bottom tab navigation (Home, Flights, Hotels, Trips, Profile)
Flight search with filters and one-way/round-trip modes
Hotel search with grid view and filters
Hotel detail page with gallery and room selection
My Trips with upcoming and past bookings
Fully interactive with realistic mock data
